subject: Welcome to Redwood — pick a quick demo window
messages:
From: Redwood Signup <no-reply@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Lee <hannah@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Welcome to Redwood — schedule a 25-minute intro

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for signing up for Redwood! We’re excited to show how our inference platform can help your team cut inference costs and stabilize latency.

Pick a 25-minute slot here so we can tailor the walkthrough to your use case: https://calendly.com/redwood/intro?token=3f7a-quickslot

What we typically cover:
- 10m: product fit & high-level architecture
- 10m: live demo (hosting modes + cost controls)
- 5m: next steps (security/compliance & procurement)

If you prefer, an SDR will reach out to coordinate — I’ve CC’d someone from our team.

— Redwood Signup Bot

Hi Hannah —

Great to see you signed up — I’m Olga on the SDR team and I’ll get you set up with a focused demo. I pulled a couple of quick windows that work for our engineers this week (all PDT):

• Wednesday Jul 16 — 11:00–11:30am
• Thursday Jul 17 — 9:00–9:30am
• Thursday Jul 17 — 2:00–2:30pm

If none of those fit, feel free to pick any available time on the Calendly link below; otherwise reply with your preferred window and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Quick context for the demo: we’ll show our Hosted API, a brief Dedicated capacity plan, and specific config tips for inference cost controls (batching + quantization). If you have folks from infrastructure or procurement, we can loop them into the invite.

Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/intro?token=3f7a-quickslot
Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Acme-Intro-Deck (intro deck attached)

Thanks — I’ll hold the slots for now.
